name: PT. Indo-Rama Synthetics Tbk
summary: PT. Indo-Rama Synthetics Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production and sale of fertilizers, polymers, fibers, yarns, and medical gloves. It operates through Spun Yarns, Polyester, Minerals, and Others segments. The company offers polyester, such as partially oriented yarns, draw textured yarns, fully drawn yarns, polyester staple fibre, PET resin and textile grade chips, and polyester filament woven grey fabrics spun; and spun yarn, including veola cotton compact, BCI, polyester, polyester sewing thread, recycled polyester, acrylic, blended, poly cotton air-jet, dyed, melange/heather, core-spun, and bamboo yarns, as well as tri-blends and linen blends.
